text.text_excerpt: Yummm! Had a really great time here. My friend and I had very delicious burgers, cooked perfectly, that were so juicy and ohgod my mouth is watering just thinking about it! For an appetizer we had a very good gorgonzola savory cheesecake. I'm all about the cheese, so I gobbled that up. Will definitely be back here to splurge on some of the entrees and specials, they sounded great. The burgers and sandwiches are reasonably priced and delicious, it came out to a little bit over $40, including tax and tip, for the both of us. We didn't buy any drinks, but they had a full bar and a nice wine list, though I can't speak to the quality of their beer and cocktail selection. The service was great,...

I thought this place was a super pricey place, but it's not! It a reasonably priced place with lots of great food options. My friend had the Grand Marnier French Toast. I really could eat that all day. and paired with the champagne cocktail? even better. I had their Frittata of the day. which was the healthier option than the French toast, but was still really yummy. They had a guy going around performing tricks with a playing card which was pretty entertaining while we were waiting for our food. At the end, right before our food was served, he kindly asked for a tip.

When I visited NOLA, we had a Groupon for $40 worth of food for the price of only $20 - a very good deal that allowed us to eat at a very good place that we would not have been able to go to without it. Everything on the menu was so damn appealing it was truly a task choosing what to order. I am not going to lie, we were pretty bummed that they were temporarily out of the Sun Dried Tomato and Pesto Terrine appetizer; but in the end it encouraged us to all order the entrees we really wanted for ourselves.
